title: Equality descent for module maps over a directed preorder
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F : I → CRing a functor [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], i ∈ I, and M,N finitely presented F(i)-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. If f,g : M → N agree after scalar extension to colimit F, there are j ≥ i such that their scalar extensions along F(i) → F(j) agree. No antisymmetry is assumed.

proof.text: Form the partial order J = Antisymmetrization I (≤), and the monotone representative functor H : J → I. The quotient is directed, by applying the quotient map to a common upper bound of representatives. The given i ensures nonemptiness. Every x ≤ H([x]), so Monotone.final_functor_iff makes H final and colimit.pre F H an isomorphism.

Extend M,N,f,g from i to its representative p. Tensor extension preserves finite presentation. Naturality of extendScalarsComp and colimit.w show the two extended maps agree after extension to colimit F. Extension along the colimit comparison isomorphism reflects equality: apply extension by the inverse, use extendScalarsComp, and then extendScalarsId. This supplies equality over colimit (H ⋙ F).

Apply the equality clause of lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent-affine to H ⋙ F, obtaining a later quotient index j. Lift to H(j), which lies above p and thus i. Naturality of extendScalarsComp and F.map_comp identifies equality of the iterated extensions with equality of direct extensions from i to H(j).

lean.statement:
theorem eventually_equal_maps_of_directed_preorder_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (i : I) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i))
    (hM : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) M)
    (hN : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) N) (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (h : (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).map f =
      (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).map g) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map f =
        (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map g
